6. Executive Analytical Findings

  • The Coastal Nominal Mirage California and New York display top nominal gross compensation (~$151,000 and ~$147,000 for Data Scientists), but rank bottom-tier in actual purchasing power (~$121,700 and ~$124,300).
  • Zero-Income-Tax State Leverage Washington and Texas yield real purchasing power that rivals or exceeds coastal hubs. Washington's 0% personal income tax preserves a real adjusted salary of ~$133,024 for Data Scientists.
  • Role Inelasticity & Base Salary Insulation Infrastructure roles (Data Architect, Data Engineer) possess baseline salaries large enough to outpace baseline living costs across all markets, whereas general analyst tiers see severe compression.
